name.value: Sandman Signature Vancouver Airport Hotel & Resort

description.value: The Sandman Signature Vancouver Airport Hotel & Resort is an upscale full-service hotel located near YVR in Richmond, BC, operated under Northland Properties' premium Signature tier. It offers standard resort-class amenities including free parking, room service, and free Wi-Fi. Its airport-adjacent location makes it a potential stopover point for cyclists using YVR, though no cycling-specific services have been confirmed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM website URL resolves to Reservations.com, a third-party booking aggregator rather than the hotel's own website, which severely limits verifiable amenity detail. Free Wi-Fi is confirmed by both the OSM tag (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and the aggregator page ('Complimentary Wifi'). No cycling-specific information — bike storage, staff procedures, laundry, or any other WWC criteria — appears anywhere in the fetched content, leaving all cycling criteria null.
concerns: OSM website URL links to Reservations.com (a third-party booking aggregator), not the hotel's official website (likely sandmanhotels.com). No cycling amenity information could be obtained as a result.
Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-855-516-1090; the Reservations.com page displays +1-888-385-6609, which appears to be Reservations.com's own booking line rather than the hotel's direct number.
Neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike knowledge) could be confirmed or denied from available content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a legitimate, operating upscale property but the OSM website URL points to a third-party booking aggregator rather than the hotel's own site, leaving all required WWC cycling criteria (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) unverifiable. Direct outreach to the hotel or review of the Sandman Hotels official website is needed before a listing decision can be made.
enrichment_extras.notes: To complete this record, query the hotel directly via the Sandman Hotels website (sandmanhotels.com) or by phone to confirm bike storage and staff procedures.
